namespace SlotThree.BaseField

open NumberField

abbrev K := CyclotomicField 3 ℚ

local instance : IsCyclotomicExtension {3} ℚ K := CyclotomicField.isCyclotomicExtension 3 ℚ

theorem class_number : NumberField.classNumber K = 1 :=
  (NumberField.classNumber_eq_one_iff).2 (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.three_pid K)

theorem three_not_dvd_class_card : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) := by
  have hc : Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) = 1 := by
    simpa only [NumberField.classNumber, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using class_number
  rw [hc]
  decide

theorem root_powers (k : ℕ) : (∃ ζ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ k)) ↔ k ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ζ, hζ⟩
    have hd := hζ.dvd_of_isCyclotomicExtension 3 (pow_ne_zero k (by decide))
    by_contra! hk
    have h9 : 9 ∣ 2 * 3 := dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow 3 (show 2 ≤ k by omega)) hd
    norm_num at h9
  · intro hk
    interval_cases k
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta 3 ℚ K, by simpa using IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec 3 ℚ K⟩

/-- This supremum is the body of the pinned tower's cZero for this field. -/
theorem maximal_level : sSup {k : ℕ | ∃ ζ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ k)} = 1 := by
  have hs : {k : ℕ | ∃ ζ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ k)} = Set.Iic 1 := by
    ext k
    exact root_powers k
  rw [hs, csSup_Iic]

#print axioms class_number
#print axioms three_not_dvd_class_card
#print axioms root_powers
#print axioms maximal_level

end SlotThree.BaseField

/-- The relative automorphism acts by transporting each integral ideal. -/
@[instance_reducible] def idealClassAction : MulAction Gal(E/K) (Cl E) where
  smul σ c := clMap σ.toRingEquiv c
  one_smul c := by
    change clMap (RingEquiv.refl E) c = c
    obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := ClassGroup.mk0_surjective c
    rw [class_map_mk0]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (Ideal.map_id I.1)
  mul_smul σ τ c := by
    change clMap (σ * τ).toRingEquiv c = clMap σ.toRingEquiv (clMap τ.toRingEquiv c)
    obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := ClassGroup.mk0_surjective c
    rw [class_map_mk0, class_map_mk0, class_map_mk0]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (Ideal.map_map (I := I.1) (RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv τ.toRingEquiv).toRingHom
      (RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv σ.toRingEquiv).toRingHom).symm

local instance : MulAction Gal(E/K) (Cl E) := idealClassAction K E

abbrev FixedClasses := MulAction.fixedPoints Gal(E/K) (Cl E)

theorem norm_invariant (σ : Gal(E/K)) (c : Cl E) :
    clNorm K (clMap σ.toRingEquiv c) = clNorm K c := by
  obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := ClassGroup.mk0_surjective c
  rw [class_map_mk0, class_norm_mk, class_norm_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (Ideal.relNorm_map_algEquiv (RingOfIntegers.mapAlgEquiv (k := K) σ) I.1)

/-- The coinvariants by a generator are the quotient by all differences σ(c)/c. -/
abbrev difference (σ : Gal(E/K)) : Cl E →* Cl E := clMap σ.toRingEquiv / MonoidHom.id _

def normOnCoinvariants (σ : Gal(E/K)) : (Cl E ⧸ (difference K E σ).range) →* Cl K :=
  QuotientGroup.lift _ (clNorm K) (by
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    change clNorm K (clMap σ.toRingEquiv c / c) = 1
    rw [map_div, norm_invariant]; exact div_self' _)

theorem norm_injective_iff (σ : Gal(E/K)) :
    Function.Injective (normOnCoinvariants K E σ) ↔
      (difference K E σ).range = (clNorm K (K' := E)).ker :=
  QuotientGroup.injective_lift_iff _ _ _

theorem fixed_card_eq_coinvariant_card (σ : Gal(E/K))
    (hgen : ∀ τ : Gal(E/K), τ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ) :
    Nat.card (FixedClasses K E) = Nat.card (Cl E ⧸ (difference K E σ).range) := by
  rw [← Subgroup.index_eq_card, Subgroup.index_range]
  apply Nat.card_congr
  apply Equiv.subtypeEquivProp
  funext c
  apply propext
  change (∀ τ : Gal(E/K), τ • c = c) ↔ clMap σ.toRingEquiv c / c = 1
  rw [div_eq_one]
  refine ⟨fun h => h σ, fun h τ => ?_⟩
  have hσ : σ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer Gal(E/K) c := h
  exact (Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr hσ) (hgen τ)

theorem one_step_of_fixed_dvd (hG : IsPGroup 3 Gal(E/K))
    (hfixed : Nat.card (FixedClasses K E) ∣ Nat.card (Cl K)) (hK : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Cl K)) :
    ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Cl E) := by

  exact hK (dvd_trans (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp
    ((hG.card_modEq_card_fixedPoints (Cl E)).symm.trans h.modEq_zero_nat)) hfixed)

theorem one_step_of_norm_injective (σ : Gal(E/K)) (hgen : ∀ τ : Gal(E/K), τ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (normOnCoinvariants K E σ)) (hG : IsPGroup 3 Gal(E/K))
    (hK : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Cl K)) : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Cl E) := by
  apply one_step_of_fixed_dvd K E hG _ hK
  rw [fixed_card_eq_coinvariant_card K E σ hgen]
  exact Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective _ hinj

/-- A subgroup of a finite p-group that normally generates the group already equals it. -/
theorem inertia_eq_top_of_normalClosure {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsPGroup 3 G) (I : Subgroup G) (h : Subgroup.normalClosure (I : Set G) = ⊤) : I = ⊤ := by
  let _ := hG.isNilpotent
  rcases eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom I with hI | ⟨M, hm, hIM⟩
  · exact hI
  · have : M.Normal := Subgroup.NormalizerCondition.normal_of_coatom M (Group.normalizerCondition_of_isNilpotent (G := G)) hm
    exact (hm.1 ((top_le_iff.mp (h ▸ Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (N := M) hIM)))).elim

/-- An inertia subgroup strictly below a finite 3-group fits inside a normal subgroup of
index three. Its fixed field is the possible cyclic cubic obstruction downstairs. -/
theorem cubic_quotient_of_proper {G : Type*} [Group G] [Finite G] (hp : IsPGroup 3 G)
    (I : Subgroup G) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ M : Subgroup G, I ≤ M ∧ M.Normal ∧ M.index = 3 := by
  obtain ⟨M, hm, hIM⟩ := (eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom I).resolve_left hI
  let _ := hp.isNilpotent
  have hn := Subgroup.NormalizerCondition.normal_of_coatom M
    (Group.normalizerCondition_of_isNilpotent (G := G)) hm
  refine ⟨M, hIM, hn, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp.exists_card_eq
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hp.to_subgroup M).exists_card_eq
  have hlt : b < a := by
    apply (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right (by decide : 1 < 3)).mp
    rw [← ha, ← hb]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne M.card_le_card_group (fun h => hm.1 (M.eq_top_of_card_eq h))
  have hd : 3 ^ (b + 1) ∣ Nat.card G := ha ▸ pow_dvd_pow _ hlt
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hMN⟩ := Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_succ hd hb
  have hne : M ≠ N := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [hb, pow_succ] at hN
    omega
  have htop := hm.2 N (lt_of_le_of_ne hMN hne)
  rw [htop, Subgroup.card_top, pow_succ, ← hb] at hN
  have he := M.card_mul_index
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.card_pos (he.trans hN)

/-- Multiply the two genuine extension degrees before applying the p-group criterion. -/
theorem cover_group (F E U : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field E] [NumberField E]
    [Field U] [NumberField U] [Algebra F E] [Algebra E U] [Algebra F U] [IsScalarTower F E U]
    [IsGalois F U] [IsGalois E U] (hdeg : Module.finrank F E = 3)
    (hp : IsPGroup 3 Gal(U/E)) (hbig : 1 < Module.finrank E U) :
    IsPGroup 3 Gal(U/F) ∧ 3 < Nat.card Gal(U/F) := by
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(U/F) = 3 * Module.finrank E U := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank F E U, hdeg]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hp.exists_card_eq
  rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank] at hm
  refine ⟨IsPGroup.of_card (n := m+1) ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcard, hm, pow_succ']
  · rw [hcard]
    omega

private theorem rec_index (K E : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field E] [NumberField E] [Algebra K E]
    [IsAbelianGalois K E] : (reciprocityMap K E).ker.index = Module.finrank K E := by
  rw [Subgroup.index_ker, MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr reciprocityMap_surjective,
    Subgroup.card_top, IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank]

/-- The Artin maps for an abstract everywhere-unramified abelian extension and the Hilbert
class field factor through nested kernels. Their indices give this divisibility of degrees. -/
theorem unramified_degree_dvd (K E : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field E] [NumberField E]
    [Algebra K E] [IsAbelianGalois K E] (hu : IsUnramifiedEverywhere K E) :
    Module.finrank K E ∣ Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) := by
  let H := hilbertClassField K (AlgebraicClosure K)
  have hle : (reciprocityMap K H).ker ≤ (reciprocityMap K E).ker := by
    rw [ker_reciprocityMap, range_ideleClassNorm_hilbertClassField]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, reciprocityMap_mk]
    apply ideleSymbol_eq_one_of_isUnramifiedEverywhere K E hu
    intro v
    have hx' : x ∈ (Modulus.one : Modulus K).congruenceSubgroup := by
      rw [Modulus.congruenceSubgroup_one]
      exact hx
    have hv := ((Modulus.one : Modulus K).mem_congruenceSubgroup.1 hx').1 v
    rw [(Modulus.exponent_eq_zero_iff _ v).2 (Modulus.not_dvd_one_ideal v)] at hv
    exact HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletionIntegers.mem_units_iff_valued_eq_one.2
      (mem_unitsLevel.1 hv).1
  have hd := Subgroup.index_dvd_of_le hle
  rw [rec_index, rec_index] at hd
  rw [Nat.card_congr (hilbertClassFieldArtinEquiv K (AlgebraicClosure K)).toEquiv,
      IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank]
  exact hd

/-- The degree-six cyclotomic field has a Minkowski bound below 5; 2 is inert and
the prime above 3 is generated by ζ₉ − 1. -/
theorem nine_pid (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {9} ℚ K] :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing (𝓞 K) := by
  let M : ℝ := (4 / Real.pi) ^ nrComplexPlaces K *
    ((Nat.factorial (Module.finrank ℚ K) : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ) ^ (Module.finrank ℚ K) *
      Real.sqrt |(NumberField.discr K : ℝ)|)
  have hm : ⌊M⌋₊ ≤ 4 := by
    have hdeg : Module.finrank ℚ K = 6 := (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.finrank 9 K).trans (by decide)
    have hdisc : discr K = -19683 := (discr_prime_pow 3 2 K).trans (by decide)
    have hpl : nrComplexPlaces K = 3 := (nrComplexPlaces_eq_totient_div_two 9 (K := K)).trans (by decide)
    have hs : Real.sqrt 19683 ≤ 141 := (Real.sqrt_le_iff).2 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    have hp : 4 / Real.pi ≤ 40 / 31 := (div_le_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).2 (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_d2])
    apply Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp
    apply (Nat.floor_lt' (by decide : 5 ≠ 0)).2
    dsimp [M]
    rw [hdeg, hdisc, hpl]
    rw [show |(((-19683 : ℤ) : ℝ))| = 19683 by norm_num]
    change (4 / Real.pi)^3 * ((720 : ℝ) / 6^6 * Real.sqrt 19683) < 5
    calc
      _ ≤ (40 / 31 : ℝ) ^ 3 * (720 / 6 ^ 6 * 141) := by gcongr
      _ < 5 := by norm_num
  have horder : orderOf (2 : ZMod 9) = 6 := by
    apply (orderOf_eq_iff (by decide)).2
    refine ⟨by decide, fun m hm hp => ?_⟩
    interval_cases m <;> decide
  apply RingOfIntegers.isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isPrincipal_of_pow_le_of_mem_primesOver_of_mem_Icc
  intro p hp prime P hP hpN
  change p ^ P.inertiaDeg ℤ ≤ ⌊M⌋₊ at hpN
  obtain ⟨hprime, hlies⟩ := hP
  have hsmall : p ≤ 4 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hp).2.trans hm
  have hcases : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by interval_cases p <;> norm_num at *
  rcases hcases with rfl | rfl
  · have hf := inertiaDeg_eq_of_not_dvd 2 K P (m := 9) (by decide)
    rw [show (2 : ZMod 9) = (2 : ℕ) from rfl] at horder
    rw [hf, horder] at hpN
    exact (by omega : False).elim
  · have e := eq_span_zeta_sub_one_of_liesOver 3 1 K (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec 9 ℚ K) P
    rw [e]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩



theorem first_step_class_card : Nat.card (Cl (Upper 0)) = 1 := by
  let _ : IsCyclotomicExtension {9} ℚ (Upper 0) := CyclotomicTransport.rational_cyclotomic 2 (by decide)
  have h := NumberField.classNumber_eq_one_iff.mpr (nine_pid (Upper 0))
  simpa only [NumberField.classNumber, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h

theorem first_step_norm_injective (σ : Gal(Upper 0 / Lower 0)) :
    Function.Injective (normOnCoinvariants (Lower 0) (Upper 0) σ) := by
  have := (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp first_step_class_card).1
  exact Function.injective_of_subsingleton _

/-- A field-specific remaining premise for each genuine step of the tower. -/
def FixedClassDivisibility : Prop :=
  ∀ k, Nat.card (FixedClasses (Lower k) (Upper k)) ∣ Nat.card (Cl (Lower k))

def CoinvariantNormInjectivity : Prop :=
  ∀ k, ∃ σ : Gal(Upper k / Lower k), (∀ τ, τ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ) ∧
    Function.Injective (normOnCoinvariants (Lower k) (Upper k) σ)

theorem fixed_of_norm (h : CoinvariantNormInjectivity) : FixedClassDivisibility := by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨σ, hg, hn⟩ := h k
  rw [fixed_card_eq_coinvariant_card _ _ σ hg]
  exact Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective _ hn

theorem regular_lower (h : FixedClassDivisibility) (k : ℕ) : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Cl (Lower k)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [CyclotomicTransport.class_card 1 (by decide)]
    simpa [CyclotomicTransport.Standard] using BaseField.three_not_dvd_class_card
  | succ k ih =>
    apply one_step_of_fixed_dvd (Lower k) (Upper k) _ (h k) ih
    apply IsPGroup.of_card (n := 1)
    simpa using (step_group k).1

theorem tower_class_hyp (h : FixedClassDivisibility) : TowerClassHyp := by
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : n ≠ 0)
  exact regular_lower h k

/-- The k=0 norm condition follows from the explicit class-number-one proof above. -/
theorem tower_of_later_norms
    (h : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → ∃ σ : Gal(Upper k / Lower k), (∀ τ, τ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ) ∧
      Function.Injective (normOnCoinvariants (Lower k) (Upper k) σ)) : TowerClassHyp := by
  apply tower_class_hyp
  apply fixed_of_norm
  intro k
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    have := (step_group 0).2
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := Gal(Upper 0 / Lower 0))
    exact ⟨σ, hσ, first_step_norm_injective σ⟩
  | succ k => exact h (k + 1) (by omega)

namespace CoherentFields

/-- Later cutoffs can discard old labels and introduce new ones above the old range. -/
def OnOldRange (E : ℕ → Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v e : ℕ, u ≤ v → e ≤ u → e ∈ E v → e ∈ E u

noncomputable def picks (l : ℕ) (K : Type) [NormedField K] {r : ℕ}
    (s : Fin r → K) (Z : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.Icc 1 Z).filter (fun e : ℕ =>
    ∃ i, ‖s i - (e : K)‖ < (l : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log l Z : ℤ)))

theorem mem_picks {l : ℕ} {K : Type} [NormedField K] {r : ℕ} {s : Fin r → K} {Z e : ℕ} :
    e ∈ picks l K s Z ↔ 1 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ Z ∧
      ∃ i, ‖s i - (e : K)‖ < (l : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log l Z : ℤ)) := by
  classical
  simp only [picks, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, and_assoc]

theorem picks_cohere {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {K : Type} [NormedField K]
    {r : ℕ} (s : Fin r → K) : OnOldRange (picks l K s) := by
  intro u v e huv heu he
  rcases mem_picks.mp he with ⟨hp,_,i,hi⟩
  refine mem_picks.mpr ⟨hp,heu,i,hi.trans_le ?_⟩
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_le
  apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀ h1
  exact neg_le_neg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.log_mono_right huv)

/-- Freeze precisely one tuple of original cohomological witnesses, then compute all its
    finite-cutoff sets. These imply the actual numerical cohomology predicate at every Z. -/
theorem coherentFirst {l R : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L]
    (h : ABound l R L) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ) (E : ℕ → Finset ℕ), (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l^c)) ∧
      (∀ Z, FirstBound l R c L Z (E Z)) ∧ OnOldRange E := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨K, _, _, _, c, r, s, hr, hζ, hb⟩, _⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c,picks l K s,hζ,fun Z => ?_,picks_cohere s⟩
  let near (i : Fin r) := (Finset.Icc 1 Z).filter (fun e : ℕ =>
    ‖s i - (e:K)‖ < (l:ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log l Z : ℤ)))
  have hsup : picks l K s Z = Finset.univ.biUnion near := by
    ext e
    simp only [mem_picks, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, near,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    aesop
  constructor
  · have hone : ∀ i, (near i).card ≤ 1 := by
      intro i
      apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
      intro a ha b hb'
      simp only [near, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at ha hb'
      exact near1 l K (s i) Z a b ha.1.1 ha.1.2 hb'.1.1 hb'.1.2 ha.2 hb'.2
    rw [hsup]
    calc
      (Finset.univ.biUnion near).card ≤ ∑ i, (near i).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin r, 1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hone i)
      _ = r := by simp
      _ ≤ R := hr
  · intro e hp heZ hne m F _ _ _ hF
    have hfar : ∀ i, (l:ℝ)^(-(Nat.log l Z : ℤ)) ≤ ‖s i - (e:K)‖ := by
      intro i
      exact le_of_not_gt (fun hnear => hne (mem_picks.mpr ⟨hp,heZ,i,hnear⟩))
    exact (hb e hp m F hF (Nat.log l Z) hfar).trans (by gcongr)

/-- At a fixed finite set of nominated labels, only exact centers persist forever:
    no rate in l or r is asserted for the cutoff. -/
theorem stabilizes {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {K : Type} [NormedField K]
    {r : ℕ} (s : Fin r → K) (B : ℕ) :
    ∃ Z₀ : ℕ, ∀ Z ≥ Z₀, ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → e ≤ B →
      (e ∈ picks l K s Z ↔ ∃ i, s i = (e : K)) := by
  classical
  have hl := (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_lt
  have hp : (1:ℝ) < l := by exact_mod_cast hl
  have sep : ∀ (e : Fin (B+1)) (i : Fin r), ∃ n : ℕ, s i ≠ (e.val : K) →
      ((l:ℝ)⁻¹)^n ≤ ‖s i - (e.val : K)‖ := by
    intro e i
    by_cases h : s i = (e.val : K)
    · exact ⟨0,fun hx => (hx h).elim⟩
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h))
      (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hp)
    exact ⟨n,fun _ => hn.le⟩
  choose n hn using sep
  let M := ∑ e, ∑ i, n e i
  have hiM (e : Fin (B+1)) (i : Fin r) : n e i ≤ M := by
    exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun (z : Fin r) _ => Nat.zero_le (n e z)) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun (z : Fin (B+1)) _ => Nat.zero_le (∑ j, n z j)) (Finset.mem_univ e))
  refine ⟨max B (l^M),fun Z hZ e he hB => ?_⟩
  have heZ := hB.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hZ)
  constructor
  · intro hex
    obtain ⟨_,_,i,hi⟩ := mem_picks.mp hex

private theorem exists_isPrimitiveRoot_of_hasMu_of_isAbField (A : AbF) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hA : A.HasMu l) (L : Type) [Field L]
    [NumberField L] (hL : IsAbField A L) : ∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ l := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, j, ζ, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hL
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hA.1.trans h1
  have hz : IsPrimitiveRoot (ζ ^ k) l := h2.pow (NeZero.pos N) (by rw [hk, mul_comm])
  have key : ζ ^ k ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField (IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup j.fieldRange) := by
    rintro ⟨τ, hτ⟩
    rw [IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff] at hτ
    obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := h2.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one
      (show (τ ζ) ^ N = 1 by rw [← map_pow, h2.pow_eq_one, map_one])
    have hker := (h3 τ a ha.symm).mp (fun x => hτ (j x) ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    have hmod := hA.2 a hker
    show τ (ζ ^ k) = ζ ^ k
    rw [map_pow, ← ha, ← pow_mul]
    have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h | h
      · subst h
        have hl1 : l ∣ 1 := Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp hmod.symm
        exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos hl1) (not_le.mpr (Fact.out : l.Prime).one_lt)
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' ha1).mp hmod.symm
    have ha' : a = l * q + 1 := (Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add ha1).mp hq
    calc ζ ^ (a * k) = ζ ^ (k + N * q) := by
          congr 1
          rw [ha', hk]
          ring
      _ = ζ ^ k := by rw [pow_add, pow_mul, h2.pow_eq_one, one_pow, mul_one]
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ (CyclotomicField N ℚ) :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois (S := {N}) (K := ℚ) (L := CyclotomicField N ℚ)
  rw [IsGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup] at key
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := key
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  rw [← hy] at hz
  exact (IsPrimitiveRoot.map_iff_of_injective j.toRingHom.injective).mp hz

theorem fillActive {eta a x b : ℝ} {ta tx tb : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ}

/-- A power-window corollary. The chosen source exponents satisfy these
inequalities throughout the analytic window as soon as its left endpoint is 2. -/
theorem fillPower {eta Ct lam a x b : ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ}
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ a ^ lam)
    (hCt : 2 ≤ Ct) (heta : 0 ≤ eta) (hscale : lam*eta ≤ 1)
    (hA : ActiveSmall eta E ⌊a^Ct⌋₊ a) (hB : ActiveSmall eta E ⌊b^Ct⌋₊ b) :
    ActiveSmall eta E ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x := by
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by linarith
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by linarith
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
  have hbx : b ^ eta ≤ a := by
    calc b ^ eta ≤ (a ^ lam) ^ eta := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) hb heta
      _ = a ^ (lam * eta) := (Real.rpow_mul ha0 _ _).symm
      _ ≤ a ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le ha1 hscale
      _ = a := Real.rpow_one _
  have h2 : a ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ a ^ Ct := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_two]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le ha1 hCt
  have hc := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (a^Ct)
  apply fillActive (Real.rpow_le_rpow ha0 hax heta)
    (Nat.floor_mono (Real.rpow_le_rpow hx0 hxb (by linarith : 0 ≤ Ct))) _ hA hB
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a-2)]

    (fun l hl _ => hBb l hl) E hE

theorem fieldAt (ψ : PChar) (Ct C eps : ℝ) (hCt : 1 ≤ Ct)
    (heps : 0 < eps) (heps52 : eps < 1/52) (hc : ThmBc Ct)
    (e : ℝ → ℕ) (he : ∀ x ≥ (1 : ℝ), PageN eps x (e x)) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, ∀ (V : ℝ) (q d : ℕ), WinPair eps V q d → PrimePair ψ.N q d →
      Real.log ((q : ℝ) * d) ≤ x ^ (eps/4) →
      BaAt (AbF.ofChar ψ) eps e (fun u => ⌊u^Ct⌋₊) q d x →
      HVAt ψ C eps e (fun u => ⌊u^Ct⌋₊) q d x →
      VAt ψ eps Ct q d (e x) x := by
  set t : ℝ → ℕ := fun u => ⌊u ^ Ct⌋₊
  have hadm : admitted 4 Ct e t := admissible_of_pageN heps heps52 hCt he
  obtain ⟨Cb, hCb⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := minusBound_le_exp_of_log_le Cb (AbF.ofChar ψ).deg
  obtain ⟨xT, hxT⟩ := error_terms_le_sqrt_exp_rpow eps K C heps
  obtain ⟨xN, hxN⟩ := log_conductor_mul_height_le_of_pageN eps Ct ψ.N heps heps52
  let L := max (max xT xN) (2 : ℝ)
  have hxTL : xT ≤ L := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hxNL : xN ≤ L := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
  intro x hLx V q d hw hpp hqd hBa hHV
  have hx2 : 2 ≤ x := (le_max_right _ _).trans hLx
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := by linarith
  intro E _ _ hE
  have hq0 : 0 < q := hw.q_prime.pos
  have hd0 : 0 < d := hw.d_prime.pos
  have hq4 : q % 4 = 3 := by
    have := hw.q_mod
    omega
  haveI : IsCMField E := isCMField_of_isChiField ψ (e x) q d hw.q_prime hq4 E hE
  have hE' : IsCompField (AbF.ofChar ψ) (e x) q d E := (isCompField_ofChar ψ (e x) q d E).2 hE
  have h2 := hBa E hE'
  have hp := hHV E hE
  have hm := hCb (AbF.ofChar ψ) 4 e t hadm x hx2 q d hpp E hE'
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := conductor_bounds_of_isChiField ψ (e x) q d hq0 hd0 E hE
  obtain ⟨-, -, ht2, htle⟩ := hadm x hx2
  have ht1 : 1 ≤ t x := by omega
  have hNt := hxN x (hxNL.trans hLx) (condF E) (t x) (e x) q d hc1 hc2 (he x hx1) ht1 htle hqd
  have hmb := hK (Module.finrank ℚ E) (condF E) (t x) (x ^ (eps / 4)) hc1 ht1 hc3 hNt
  have hm' := VVminusLe.mono hm hmb
  have hv := vvle_of_parts h2 hm' hp
  have hu1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ↑(condF E) * ↑(t x) := by
    have a : (1 : ℝ) ≤ condF E := by exact_mod_cast hc1
    have b : (1 : ℝ) ≤ t x := by exact_mod_cast ht1
    nlinarith
  have htot := hxT x (hxTL.trans hLx) _ hu1 hNt
  exact VVle.mono hv le_rfl htot

/-- One collection of sets and one prime pair can be evaluated at arbitrarily
many certified ordinates of the outer range. The inputs remain explicit. -/
theorem fieldTransport (wA wB : ℝ) (K : BConst) (Ct eps : ℝ) (psi : PChar)
    (hCt : 1 ≤ Ct) (heps : 0 < eps) (heps52 : eps < 1/52)
    (hj : Joint K wA wB Ct) (hp : PointHV) (hc : ThmBc Ct)
    (e : ℝ → ℕ) (hpage : ∀ x ≥ (1 : ℝ), PageN eps x (e x)) :
    ∃ r₁ r₂ : ℕ, ∃ L X0 : ℝ, ∀ X ≥ X0, ∀ (V : ℝ) (q d : ℕ),
      WinPair eps V q d → PrimePair psi.N q d →
      2*X^Ct+1 < (q:ℝ) → 2*X^Ct+1 < (d:ℝ) →
      (∀ k ∈ [psi.N, ordC psi, pK psi, hStar psi, pOne psi, r₁, r₂], k < q ∧ k < d) →
      Real.log ((q:ℝ)*d) ≤ X ^ (eps/(4*Jchi K Ct eps psi)) →
      ∃ (EA : Finset ℕ) (EB : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
        EA.card ≤ K.R0 (AbF.ofChar psi) ∧ (∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, (EB l).card ≤ K.Rl l (Lchi psi l)) ∧
        ∀ x ≥ L, X ^ (1/Jchi K Ct eps psi) ≤ x → x ≤ X →
          ActiveSmall (wA*eps/K.CK) EA ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x →
          (∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, ActiveSmall (wB*eps/K.CK) (EB l) ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x) →
          VAt psi eps Ct q d (e x) x := by
  let t : ℝ → ℕ := fun x => ⌊x^Ct⌋₊
  have ht := admissible_of_pageN heps heps52 hCt hpage
  have hct0 : 0 < Ct := by linarith
  have hJ : 0 < Jchi K Ct eps psi := BConst.J_pos K hct0 heps _ _ _
  obtain ⟨X0,hX0⟩ := hj (AbF.ofChar psi) (Bchi psi) (Lchi psi) (primeSetBoundData_of_primitiveChar psi) eps 4 heps heps52
  obtain ⟨C, r₁, r₂, hheight⟩ := heightAt hp K Ct hct0 psi
  obtain ⟨L,hL⟩ := fieldAt psi Ct C eps hCt heps heps52 hc e hpage
  refine ⟨r₁,r₂,max 2 L,X0,?_⟩
  intro X hX V q d hw hpair hq hd hlist hlog
  obtain ⟨EA,EB,hEA,hEB,hh⟩ := hX0 e t ht X hX q d hpair hlog
  refine ⟨EA,EB,hEA,hEB,?_⟩
  intro x hLx hxlo hxhi hactA hactB
  have hx2 : 2 ≤ x := (le_max_left _ _).trans hLx
  have hloc := hh x hxlo hxhi hactA hactB
  have hv := hheight eps 4 e t ht X x q d hx2 hxhi hpair hq hd hlist hloc.2
  have hlogx := hlog.trans (logs.2.1 _ eps X x hJ heps (by linarith) hxlo)
  exact hL x ((le_max_right _ _).trans hLx) V q d hw hpair hlogx hloc.1 hv
/-- Supply two active endpoint certificates to the field-valued local transport.
The same parameters appear throughout the interval. -/
theorem fieldFill (psi : PChar) (e : ℝ → ℕ) (eps Ct a x b lam ea eb : ℝ)
    (q d : ℕ) (EA : Finset ℕ) (EB : ℕ → Finset ℕ)
    (hCt : 2 ≤ Ct) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ a^lam)
    (hea : 0 ≤ ea) (heb : 0 ≤ eb) (hsa : lam*ea ≤ 1) (hsb : lam*eb ≤ 1)

    (hleftA : ActiveSmall ea EA ⌊a^Ct⌋₊ a)
    (hleftB : ∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, ActiveSmall eb (EB l) ⌊a^Ct⌋₊ a)
    (hrightA : ActiveSmall ea EA ⌊b^Ct⌋₊ b)
    (hrightB : ∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, ActiveSmall eb (EB l) ⌊b^Ct⌋₊ b) :
    VAt psi eps Ct q d (e x) x :=
  hloc x hax hxb (fillPower ha hax hxb hb hCt hea hsa hleftA hrightA)
    (fun l hl => fillPower ha hax hxb hb hCt heb hsb (hleftB l hl) (hrightB l hl))
/-- At the source scale a genuine WinPair supplies every common size condition,
including the exceptional auxiliary primes of the pointwise height theorem. -/
theorem windowPairTransport (wA wB : ℝ) (K : BConst) (Ct eps : ℝ) (psi : PChar)
    (hCt : 1 ≤ Ct) (heps : 0 < eps) (heps52 : eps < 1/52)
    (hj : Joint K wA wB Ct) (hp : PointHV) (hc : ThmBc Ct)
    (e : ℝ → ℕ) (hpage : ∀ x ≥ (1 : ℝ), PageN eps x (e x)) :
    ∃ X0 : ℝ, ∀ X ≥ X0, ∀ q d : ℕ, WinPair eps (X ^ (1/Jchi K Ct eps psi)) q d →
      ∃ (EA : Finset ℕ) (EB : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
        EA.card ≤ K.R0 (AbF.ofChar psi) ∧ (∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, (EB l).card ≤ K.Rl l (Lchi psi l)) ∧
        ∀ x, X ^ (1/Jchi K Ct eps psi) ≤ x → x ≤ X →
          ActiveSmall (wA*eps/K.CK) EA ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x →
          (∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, ActiveSmall (wB*eps/K.CK) (EB l) ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x) →
          VAt psi eps Ct q d (e x) x := by
  set J := Jchi K Ct eps psi
  have hJ : 0 < J := BConst.J_pos K (by linarith) heps _ _ _
  obtain ⟨r₁,r₂,L,X0,hmain⟩ := fieldTransport wA wB K Ct eps psi hCt heps heps52 hj hp hc e hpage
  let indices := [psi.N, ordC psi, pK psi, hStar psi, pOne psi, r₁, r₂]
  obtain ⟨XB,hXB⟩ := eventually_winPair_gt_power eps J Ct (indices.sum : ℝ) heps hJ
  obtain ⟨Y0,hY0⟩ := log_mul_le_rpow_of_winPair eps heps
  set T := max 2 (max L Y0)
  have hT : 2 ≤ T := le_max_left _ _
  have hTL : L ≤ T := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hTY : Y0 ≤ T := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨max (max X0 XB) (T ^ J), ?_⟩
  intro X hX q d hw
  have hX0 : X0 ≤ X := (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hX)
  have hXB' : XB ≤ X := (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hX)
  have hTX : T^J ≤ X := (le_max_right _ _).trans hX
  have hXpos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _) hTX
  have hlow : T ≤ X ^ (1/J) := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ T) J) hTX (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1/J)
    rwa [← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith : 0 ≤ T), mul_one_div_cancel hJ.ne', Real.rpow_one] at h
  obtain ⟨hq,hd,hPq,hPd⟩ := hXB X hXB' q d hw
  have hlist : ∀ k ∈ indices, k < q ∧ k < d := by
    intro k hk
    have hsum : k ≤ indices.sum := List.le_sum_of_mem hk
    have hcast : (k:ℝ) ≤ (indices.sum:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsum
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hcast.trans_lt hPq, by exact_mod_cast hcast.trans_lt hPd⟩
  have hcop : ∀ r : ℕ, r.Prime → psi.N < r → r.Coprime psi.N := by
    intro r hr hlt
    have hN : 0 < psi.N := (AbF.ofChar psi).pos
    exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hr).2 (fun hdvd => (not_le_of_gt hlt) (Nat.le_of_dvd hN hdvd))
  have hN := hlist psi.N (by simp [indices])
  have hpp : PrimePair psi.N q d :=
    ⟨hw.q_prime, hw.q_mod, hw.d_prime, hw.d_mod,
      Nat.Coprime.mul (hcop q hw.q_prime hN.1) (hcop d hw.d_prime hN.2)⟩
  have hlog := hY0 _ (hTY.trans hlow) q d hw
  have hpow : (X^(1/J))^(eps/4) = X^(eps/(4*J)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hXpos.le]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [hpow] at hlog
  obtain ⟨EA,EB,hA,hB,hall⟩ := hmain X hX0 _ q d hw hpp hq hd hlist hlog
  exact ⟨EA,EB,hA,hB,fun x hx hx' => hall x ((hTL.trans hlow).trans hx) hx hx'⟩
/-- Fix the joint prime witness before exposing any endpoint test. The retained
PairGood includes original twist estimates and boxes on the whole outer interval. -/
theorem commonPairGood (wA wB : ℝ) (K : BConst) (hK1 : 1 ≤ K.CK)
    (Ct eps : ℝ) (psi : PChar) (hCt : 1 ≤ Ct) (heps : 0 < eps) (heps52 : eps < 1/52)
    (hj : Joint K wA wB Ct) (hp : PointHV) (hc : ThmBc Ct) (hpair : PairEx)
    (e : ℝ → ℕ) (hpage : ∀ x ≥ (1 : ℝ), PageN eps x (e x)) :
    let J := Jchi K Ct eps psi
    ∃ X0 : ℝ, ∀ X ≥ X0, ∃ (q d : ℕ) (EA : Finset ℕ) (EB : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
      PairGood psi.N eps (X ^ (1/J)) X q d ∧
        EA.card ≤ K.R0 (AbF.ofChar psi) ∧ (∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, (EB l).card ≤ K.Rl l (Lchi psi l)) ∧
        ∀ x, X ^ (1/J) ≤ x → x ≤ X →
          ActiveSmall (wA*eps/K.CK) EA ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x →
          (∀ l ∈ Bchi psi, ActiveSmall (wB*eps/K.CK) (EB l) ⌊x^Ct⌋₊ x) →
          VAt psi eps Ct q d (e x) x := by
  let J := Jchi K Ct eps psi
  have hJ1 : 1 ≤ J := by
    have hratio : 1 ≤ 2*K.CK*Ct/eps := (le_div_iff₀ heps).2 (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hK1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hCt)])
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2)) (one_le_pow₀ hratio)
  have hJ : 0 < J := zero_lt_one.trans_le hJ1
  obtain ⟨X0,hX0⟩ := windowPairTransport wA wB K Ct eps psi hCt heps heps52 hj hp hc e hpage
  obtain ⟨Y0,hY0⟩ := hpair psi.N (AbF.ofChar psi).pos eps J heps heps52 hJ1
  set T := max 2 Y0
  have hT : 0 < T := by have := le_max_left (2:ℝ) Y0; linarith
  refine ⟨max X0 (T^J), ?_⟩
  intro X hX
  have hT' : T^J ≤ X := (le_max_right _ _).trans hX
  have hXpos : 0 < X := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hT J).trans_le hT'
  have hlow : T ≤ X^(1/J) := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hT.le J) hT' (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1/J)
    rwa [← Real.rpow_mul hT.le, mul_one_div_cancel hJ.ne', Real.rpow_one] at h
  obtain ⟨q,d,hgood⟩ := hY0 _ ((le_max_right _ _).trans hlow)
  have hxid : (X^(1/J))^J = X := by rw [one_div,Real.rpow_inv_rpow hXpos.le hJ.ne']
  rw [hxid] at hgood
  obtain ⟨EA,EB,hA,hB,hall⟩ := hX0 X ((le_max_left _ _).trans hX) q d hgood.pair
  exact ⟨q,d,EA,EB,hgood,hA,hB,hall⟩

namespace FixedRoster

theorem order_one : ordC PChar.one = 1 := by
  exact orderOf_one

theorem prime_k : pK PChar.one = 7 := by
  let T : Set ℕ := {p | p.Prime ∧ p % 4 = 3 ∧ 7 ≤ p ∧ p.Coprime 1}
  change sInf T = 7
  have hm : 7 ∈ T := by decide
  exact le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hm) ((Nat.sInf_mem ⟨7, hm⟩).2.2.1)

theorem prime_one : pOne PChar.one = 3 := by
  unfold pOne
  rw [order_one, prime_k]
  let T : Set ℕ := {p | p.Prime ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD ordCompl[2] (1 : ℕ)] ∧ p.Coprime 14}
  change sInf T = 3
  have hm : 3 ∈ T := by
    refine ⟨by decide, ?_, by decide⟩
    simp [Nat.factorization_one, Nat.ModEq]
  have hmin := Nat.sInf_mem (show T.Nonempty from ⟨3, hm⟩)
  have hlo := Nat.Prime.two_le hmin.1
  have hne : sInf T ≠ 2 := by
    intro h
    have hc := hmin.2.2
    rw [h] at hc
    exact (by decide : ¬Nat.Coprime 2 14) hc
  exact le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hm) (by omega)

  unfold Bchi
  rw [order_one, prime_k, prime_one]
  have hpos : 0 < hStar PChar.one := NumberField.classNumber_pos _
  apply Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
  apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
  refine ⟨by decide, Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨by decide, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · change 7 ∣ 7 * hStar PChar.one * 3
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_right 7 _) _
  · change 7 * hStar PChar.one * 3 ≠ 0
    positivity

    Bchi PChar.one = {3, 7} := by
  unfold Bchi
  rw [order_one, prime_k, prime_one, h]
  change insert 3 (((7 * 3 : ℕ).primeFactors).erase 2) = {3, 7}
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul (by decide) (by decide),
    Nat.Prime.primeFactors (by decide : Nat.Prime 7),
    Nat.Prime.primeFactors (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)]

/-- Every semilinear automorphism of the ambient field preserves this Hilbert class field. -/
theorem stable (E Ω : Type) [Field E] [NumberField E] [Field Ω] [Algebra E Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [IsTotallyComplex E] (ψ : E ≃+* E) (σ : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (hc : ∀ x, σ (algebraMap E Ω x) = algebraMap E Ω (ψ x)) (x : Ω)
    (hx : x ∈ hilbertClassField E Ω) : σ x ∈ hilbertClassField E Ω := by
  let H := hilbertClassField E Ω
  let J := tr ψ σ hc H
  have hm := mem_tr ψ σ hc H
  let φ : H ≃+* J := resEquiv σ H J hm
  have hs : ∀ a, φ (algebraMap E H a) = algebraMap E J (ψ a) := resEquiv_algebraMap ψ σ hc H J hm
  have compat : (algebraMap E J).comp ψ.toRingHom = φ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E H) :=
    RingHom.ext fun a => (hs a).symm
  let : FiniteDimensional E J := finite_of_resEquiv ψ σ hc H J hm
  let : IsGalois E J := IsGalois.of_equiv_equiv (F := E) (E := H) (f := ψ) (g := φ) compat
  let φG := galEquiv ψ φ hs
  let : IsMulCommutative Gal(J/E) := IsMulCommutative.of_comm fun a b => by
    apply φG.symm.injective
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    exact (isMulCommutative_iff.mp (inferInstance : IsMulCommutative Gal(H/E))) _ _
  let : IsAbelianGalois E J := {}
  have hu := isUnramifiedEverywhere_hilbertClassField E Ω
  have away : IsUnramifiedOutside (∅ : Set (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 E))) H :=
    fun v _ => hu.1 v
  have same : Corr ψ (∅ : Set (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 E))) ∅ := fun v => by simp
  have uj := unram_tr ψ σ hc same away

theorem hilbert_galois (F E Ω : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field E] [NumberField E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsGalois F E] [IsTotallyComplex E] [Field Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [IsScalarTower F E Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Normal F Ω]
    [Algebra F (hilbertClassField E Ω)] [IsScalarTower F E (hilbertClassField E Ω)] :
    IsGalois F (hilbertClassField E Ω) := by

  apply eq_bot_iff.2

    have hc' := symm_compat s.toRingEquiv σ.toRingEquiv hc

    let f : H ≃+* H := resEquiv σ.toRingEquiv H H hm

      resEquiv_algebraMap s.toRingEquiv σ.toRingEquiv hc H H hm

      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E H, hf, s.commutes]
    exact (algebraMap E H).injective ((hf y).symm.trans (hx g trivial))
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ z

/-- An everywhere-unramified upstairs step does not alter the order of inertia. -/
theorem relative_inertia_card (hu : IsUnramifiedEverywhere E U)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F)) (Q : Ideal (𝓞 U)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver v.asIdeal] :
    Nat.card (Q.inertia Gal(U/F)) = (Q.under (𝓞 E)).ramificationIdx (𝓞 F) := by
  have hb : Q ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot v.ne_bot Q
  let w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 E) := ⟨Q.under (𝓞 E), inferInstance, Ideal.under_ne_bot _ hb⟩
  have hw : Q.LiesOver w.asIdeal := by
    change Q.LiesOver (Q.under (𝓞 E))
    infer_instance
  have := v.isMaximal
  have : Finite (𝓞 F ⧸ v.asIdeal) := Ideal.finiteQuotientOfFreeOfNeBot _ v.ne_bot
  calc
    Nat.card (Q.inertia Gal(U/F)) = v.asIdeal.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 U) :=
      Ideal.card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn (G := Gal(U/F)) v.asIdeal Q
    _ = Q.ramificationIdx (𝓞 F) := ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx _ Q Gal(U/F)
    _ = _ := by rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower (R := 𝓞 F) w.asIdeal Q,
                       (hu.1 w).ramificationIdx_eq_one hw, mul_one]

end

variable {F U : Type} [Field F] [NumberField F] [Field U] [NumberField U] [Algebra F U]
  [IsGalois F U]

theorem inertia_conjugates_le_normal (H : Subgroup Gal(U/F)) [H.Normal]
    (p : Ideal (𝓞 F)) (Q Q' : Ideal (𝓞 U)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q'.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver p] [Q'.LiesOver p] (h : Q.inertia Gal(U/F) ≤ H) :
    Q'.inertia Gal(U/F) ≤ H := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.exists_smul_eq_of_isGaloisGroup p Q Q' Gal(U/F)
  intro σ hσ
  rw [← hg, mem_inertia_smul_iff] at hσ
  have hc := (inferInstance : H.Normal).conj_mem (g⁻¹ * σ * g) (h hσ) g
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hc

/-- Restrict inertia onto a normal fixed field. Containment in its fixing subgroup
forces every finite inertia group in that fixed field to be trivial. -/
theorem fixed_unramified [IsTotallyComplex F] (H : Subgroup Gal(U/F)) [H.Normal]
    (h : ∀ (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F)) (Q : Ideal (𝓞 U)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver v.asIdeal],
      Q.inertia Gal(U/F) ≤ H) : IsUnramifiedEverywhere F (fixedField H) := by
  let M := fixedField H
  change IsUnramifiedEverywhere F M
  constructor
  · intro v
    apply Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_ramificationIdx_eq_one.mpr
    intro P hP hp
    obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQP⟩⟩ := P.nonempty_primesOver (S := 𝓞 U)
    have hv := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P v.asIdeal
    have hker : Q.inertia Gal(U/F) ≤ (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M).ker := by
      rw [M.restrictNormalHom_ker]
      change Q.inertia Gal(U/F) ≤ (fixedField H).fixingSubgroup
      rw [IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_fixedField]
      exact h v Q
    have hBot : (Q.inertia Gal(U/F)).map (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M) = ⊥ := by
      rw [Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff]
      exact hker
    rw [map_inertia_restrictNormalHom, ← Ideal.over_def Q P] at hBot
    have := v.isMaximal
    have : Finite (𝓞 F ⧸ v.asIdeal) := Ideal.finiteQuotientOfFreeOfNeBot _ v.ne_bot
    rw [← ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx v.asIdeal P Gal(M/F),
      ← card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn (G := Gal(M/F)) v.asIdeal P, Subgroup.card_eq_one]
    exact hBot
  · intro v w hw
    rw [InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff, hw]
    exact Or.inr (IsTotallyComplex.isComplex v)

/-- Descend an unramified extension of a cubic layer, provided the upstairs Galois
group has order greater than three and its proper subgroups lie in a normal subgroup
of index three. The latter is the finite 3-group lemma. -/
theorem descend (k : ℕ) (U : Type) [Field U] [NumberField U]
    [Algebra (Lower k) U] [Algebra (Upper k) U] [IsScalarTower (Lower k) (Upper k) U]
    [IsGalois (Lower k) U] (hu : IsUnramifiedEverywhere (Upper k) U)
    (hbig : 3 < Nat.card Gal(U/Lower k))
    (select : ∀ I : Subgroup Gal(U/Lower k), I ≠ ⊤ →
      ∃ H : Subgroup Gal(U/Lower k), I ≤ H ∧ H.Normal ∧ H.index = 3) :
    ∃ M : IntermediateField (Lower k) U,
      IsAbelianGalois (Lower k) M ∧ Module.finrank (Lower k) M = 3 ∧
      IsUnramifiedEverywhere (Lower k) M := by
  classical
  let _ := totally_complex k
  let _ := step_galois k
  obtain ⟨p, hsing⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_one.mp (unique_over_three k)
  have hpMem : p ∈ (overPrime 3).primesOver (𝓞 (Lower k)) := hsing ▸ Set.mem_singleton _
  obtain ⟨hp, hp3⟩ := hpMem
  let v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 (Lower k)) :=
    ⟨p, hp, Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot (show overPrime 3 ≠ ⊥ by norm_num [overPrime]) p⟩
  let _ := v.isMaximal
  obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQv⟩⟩ := v.asIdeal.nonempty_primesOver (S := 𝓞 U)
  have hP : (Q.under (𝓞 (Upper k))).LiesOver v.asIdeal := Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot Q _ v.asIdeal
  have h3 : Nat.card (Q.inertia Gal(U/Lower k)) = 3 := by
    rw [relative_inertia_card hu v Q, ← ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx v.asIdeal
      (Q.under (𝓞 (Upper k))) Gal(Upper k / Lower k)]
    exact (ramification_three k p).2.1
  have hproper : Q.inertia Gal(U/Lower k) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [h, Subgroup.card_top] at h3
    omega
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hn, hi⟩ := select _ hproper
  let M := fixedField H
  have hd : Module.finrank (Lower k) M = 3 := by
    rw [IntermediateField.finrank_eq_fixingSubgroup_index, IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_fixedField, hi]
  have hc : Nat.card Gal(M/Lower k) = 3 :=
    (IsGaloisGroup.card_eq_finrank _ (Lower k) M).trans hd
  let _ : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have hcyc : IsCyclic Gal(M/Lower k) := isCyclic_of_prime_card hc
  have hab : IsAbelianGalois (Lower k) M := {}
  refine ⟨M, hab, hd, fixed_unramified H ?_⟩
  intro w Q' hQ' hQw
  by_cases h3w : w.asIdeal.LiesOver (overPrime 3)
  · have hmem : w.asIdeal ∈ (overPrime 3).primesOver (𝓞 (Lower k)) := ⟨w.isPrime, h3w⟩
    have heq : w.asIdeal = v.asIdeal := by simpa only [hsing, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hmem
    have hQp : Q'.LiesOver v.asIdeal := heq ▸ hQw
    exact inertia_conjugates_le_normal H v.asIdeal Q Q' hH
  · have hP' : (Q'.under (𝓞 (Upper k))).LiesOver w.asIdeal :=
      Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot Q' _ w.asIdeal
    have hw := (unramified_iff k w.asIdeal w.ne_bot).mpr h3w
    have h1 : Nat.card (Q'.inertia Gal(U/Lower k)) = 1 :=
      (relative_inertia_card hu w Q').trans (hw.ramificationIdx_eq_one hP')
    rw [Subgroup.card_eq_one.mp h1]
    exact bot_le

namespace SlotThree.NextLayer

open NumberField Ideal SlotThree.CyclotomicTransport

local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩

/-- The bottom and top are the original consecutive layers, starting at the third roots. -/
abbrev Lower (k : ℕ) := Layer (k + 1)
abbrev Upper (k : ℕ) := Layer (k + 2)

/-- Use the same inclusion as the original class-group norm in the tower. -/
instance stepAlgebra (k : ℕ) : Algebra (Lower k) (Upper k) :=
  (IntermediateField.inclusion
    (UpperTheory.V.Tower.Fn_le_succ 3 Base (AlgebraicClosure Base) (k+1))).toRingHom.toAlgebra

private instance cyc (k : ℕ) : IsCyclotomicExtension {3 ^ (k + 1)} ℚ (Lower k) :=
  rational_cyclotomic (k+1) (by omega)

private instance gal (k : ℕ) : IsGalois ℚ (Lower k) :=
  IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {3 ^ (k+1)} ℚ (Lower k)

theorem step_galois (k : ℕ) : IsGalois (Lower k) (Upper k) :=
  IsGalois.tower_top_of_isGalois ℚ (Lower k) (Upper k)

theorem absolute_degree (k : ℕ) : Module.finrank ℚ (Lower k) = 3 ^ k * 2 := by
  rw [IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.finrank (3 ^ (k+1)), Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)]

theorem step_degree (k : ℕ) : Module.finrank (Lower k) (Upper k) = 3 := by
  have : Module.Free (Lower k) (Upper k) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing ..
  have h := Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (Lower k) (Upper k)
  rw [absolute_degree k, absolute_degree (k+1), pow_succ] at h
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by positivity : 0 < 3 ^ k * 2)
  simpa only [Nat.mul_right_comm] using h

theorem step_group (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card Gal(Upper k / Lower k) = 3 ∧ IsCyclic Gal(Upper k / Lower k) := by
  let _ := step_galois k
  have h := (IsGaloisGroup.card_eq_finrank Gal(Upper k / Lower k) (Lower k) (Upper k)).trans (step_degree k)
  exact ⟨h, isCyclic_of_prime_card h⟩

abbrev overPrime (q : ℕ) : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}

theorem unique_over_three (k : ℕ) : ((overPrime 3).primesOver (𝓞 (Lower k))).ncard = 1 :=
  IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ncard_primesOver_of_prime_pow 3 k (Lower k)

theorem ramification_three (k : ℕ) (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Lower k))) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver (overPrime 3)] :
    (P.primesOver (𝓞 (Upper k))).ncard = 1 ∧ P.ramificationIdxIn (𝓞 (Upper k)) = 3 ∧
      P.inertiaDegIn (𝓞 (Upper k)) = 1 := by
  let _ := step_galois k
  have hcount := ncard_primesOver_mul_ncard_primesOver (p := overPrime 3) P Gal(Lower k/ℚ)
    (𝓞 (Upper k)) Gal(Upper k/ℚ)
  rw [unique_over_three k, unique_over_three (k+1), one_mul] at hcount
  have he := ramificationIdxIn_mul_ramificationIdxIn (p := overPrime 3) P Gal(Lower k/ℚ)
    (𝓞 (Upper k)) Gal(Upper k/ℚ) Gal(Upper k/Lower k)
  rw [IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdxIn_eq_of_prime_pow 3 k (Lower k),
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdxIn_eq_of_prime_pow 3 (k+1) (Upper k), pow_succ] at he
  have hf := inertiaDegIn_mul_inertiaDegIn (overPrime 3) P Gal(Lower k/ℚ)
    (𝓞 (Upper k)) Gal(Upper k/ℚ) Gal(Upper k/Lower k)
  rw [IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.inertiaDegIn_eq_of_prime_pow 3 k (Lower k),
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.inertiaDegIn_eq_of_prime_pow 3 (k+1) (Upper k), one_mul] at hf
  refine ⟨hcount, ?_, hf⟩
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by positivity : 0 < 3 ^ k * (3-1))
  simpa only [Nat.mul_right_comm] using he

theorem unramified_away (k q : ℕ) [hp : Fact q.Prime] (hne : q ≠ 3)
    (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Lower k))) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver (overPrime q)] :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn (𝓞 (Upper k)) P := by
  apply Algebra.isUnramifiedIn_iff_forall_ramificationIdx_eq_one.mpr
  intro Q _ hQ
  have := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P (overPrime q)
  have hnd : ¬ q ∣ 3 ^ (k+2) := by
    intro hd
    have h3 := hp.out.dvd_of_dvd_pow hd
    exact hne ((Nat.dvd_prime (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)).mp h3 |>.resolve_left hp.out.ne_one)
  have he := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.ramificationIdx_eq_of_not_dvd q (Upper k) Q hnd
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower P Q] at he
  exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one (Dvd.intro_left _ he)

/-- All source fields occurring here have no real places. -/
theorem totally_complex (k : ℕ) : IsTotallyComplex (Lower k) := by
  apply IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isTotallyComplex (n := 3 ^ (k+1))
  have h : 0 < (3 : ℕ) ^ k := by positivity
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

/-- The unique prime over three is generated by the cyclotomic uniformizer. -/
theorem prime_over_three_generator (k : ℕ) (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Lower k))) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (overPrime 3)] :
    P = Ideal.span {((IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec (3 ^ (k+1)) ℚ (Lower k)).toInteger - 1)} :=
  IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.eq_span_zeta_sub_one_of_liesOver 3 k (Lower k) _ P

theorem ramified_class_trivial (k : ℕ) (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Lower k))) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (overPrime 3)] (h0 : P ≠ ⊥) :
    ClassGroup.mk0 ⟨P, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero h0⟩ = 1 := by
  apply (ClassGroup.mk0_eq_one_iff _).mpr
  rw [prime_over_three_generator k P]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

theorem unramified_iff (k : ℕ) (P : Ideal (𝓞 (Lower k))) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn (𝓞 (Upper k)) P ↔ ¬ P.LiesOver (overPrime 3) := by
  constructor
  · intro hu hl
    let _ := hl
    let _ := step_galois k
    obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQP⟩⟩ := P.nonempty_primesOver (S := 𝓞 (Upper k))
    have h3 := (ramification_three k P).2.1
    rw [ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx P Q Gal(Upper k/Lower k),
      hu.ramificationIdx_eq_one hQP] at h3
    contradiction
  · intro h
    let q := (P.under ℤ).absNorm
    have hne : NeZero P := ⟨hP⟩
    have hq : Fact q.Prime := ⟨Nat.absNorm_under_prime P⟩
    have hl : P.LiesOver (overPrime q) := Int.liesOver_span_absNorm P
    exact unramified_away k q (fun e => h (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun x => P.LiesOver (overPrime x)) e) hl)) P

/-- Exactly one nonzero prime downstairs ramifies in each actual source-field step. -/
theorem unique_ramified_prime (k : ℕ) :
    ∃! P : Ideal (𝓞 (Lower k)), P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ ⊥ ∧ ¬ Algebra.IsUnramifiedIn (𝓞 (Upper k)) P := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hp⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_one.mp (unique_over_three k)
  have hm : P ∈ (overPrime 3).primesOver (𝓞 (Lower k)) := hp ▸ Set.mem_singleton _
  obtain ⟨hP, hP3⟩ := hm
  have h0 : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot (show overPrime 3 ≠ ⊥ by norm_num [overPrime]) P
  refine ⟨P, ⟨hP, h0, fun hu => (unramified_iff k P h0).mp hu hP3⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro Q ⟨hQ, hQ0, hram⟩
  have hl : Q.LiesOver (overPrime 3) := not_not.mp (hram ∘ (unramified_iff k Q hQ0).mpr)
  have hmem : Q ∈ (overPrime 3).primesOver (𝓞 (Lower k)) := ⟨hQ,hl⟩
  simpa only [hp, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hmem

#print axioms absolute_degree
#print axioms step_degree
#print axioms step_galois
#print axioms step_group
#print axioms unique_over_three
#print axioms ramification_three
#print axioms unramified_away
#print axioms totally_complex
#print axioms prime_over_three_generator
#print axioms ramified_class_trivial
#print axioms unramified_iff

noncomputable def h (eps Y : ℝ) := z eps Y * (Real.log Y)^2
noncomputable def nextInt (a : ℝ) : ℝ := (⌊a⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1

/-- All tests concern the predetermined scales, and none mention either selected prime. -/
def Guard (M : ℕ) (eps J Y V : ℝ) : Prop :=

  Real.exp (z eps V / 2) < nextInt (Real.exp (z eps Y / 2)) ∧
  Real.exp (h eps V / 2) < nextInt (Real.exp (h eps Y / 2)) ∧

theorem incompatibleQ {eps Y V : ℝ} {q d q' d' : ℕ}
    (a : WinPair eps Y q d) (b : WinPair eps V q' d') (sep : 2*z eps Y ≤ z eps V) : q ≠ q' := by
  rintro rfl
  have hl := b.q_lo
  have hu := a.q_up
  unfold z at sep
  linarith

theorem incompatibleD {eps Y V : ℝ} {q d q' d' : ℕ}
    (a : WinPair eps Y q d) (b : WinPair eps V q' d') (sep : 2*h eps Y ≤ h eps V) : d ≠ d' := by
  rintro rfl
  have hl := b.d_lo
  have hu := a.d_up
  unfold h z at sep
  linarith

private theorem next_le {a : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hlt : a < n) : nextInt a ≤ n := by
  have hn := (Nat.floor_lt ha).2 hlt
  have hnn : ⌊a⌋₊ + 1 ≤ n := hn
  unfold nextInt
  exact_mod_cast hnn

    (he : 0 ≤ eps) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) (hV : Y ≤ V) (g : Guard M eps J Y V)
    (p : WinPair eps Y q d) : WinPair eps V q d := by
  rcases g with ⟨gz,gq,gd,-,-⟩
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have hz : z eps Y ≤ z eps V := Real.rpow_le_rpow hY0.le hV (by positivity)
  have hh : h eps Y ≤ h eps V :=
    mul_le_mul hz (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.log_nonneg hY) (Real.log_le_log hY0 hV) 2)
      (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
  have qcast : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast p.q_prime.pos
  have dcast : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast p.d_prime.pos
  have pq := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt qcast).1 p.q_lo
  have pd := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt dcast).1 p.d_lo
  refine ⟨p.q_prime,p.q_mod,(Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt qcast).2 (gq.trans_le (next_le (Real.exp_pos _).le pq)),
    p.q_up.trans hz,p.d_prime,p.d_mod,(Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt dcast).2 (gd.trans_le (next_le (Real.exp_pos _).le pd)),
    p.d_up.trans hh,p.d_q,?_⟩

  have := next_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hY0.le _) hrY

theorem goodTransport {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) {eps J Y V : ℝ} {q d : ℕ}
    (he : 0 ≤ eps) (hY : 1 ≤ Y) (hV : Y ≤ V)
    (g : Guard M eps J Y V) (p : PairGood (2*M) eps Y (Y^(J+1)) q d) :
    PairGood M eps V (V^J) q d := by
  let _ : NeZero (2*M) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have div : M ∣ 2*M := dvd_mul_left M 2
  have div8 : 8*M ∣ 8*(2*M) := Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ div
  have divAll : 2*M*q*d ∣ 2*(2*M)*q*d := by
    exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ div) q) d
  refine ⟨rowTransport he hY hV g p.pair,p.coprime.coprime_dvd_left div,?_,?_⟩
  · intro ξ i j hij N _ χ hc y hy hyy
    let ξ' := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel div ξ
    have hc' : An.Induces χ (tw (fun n => ξ' (n : ZMod (2*M))) q d i j) (2*(2*M)*q*d) := by
      refine ⟨hc.1,?_⟩
      intro n hn
      have hdn : (2*M) ∣ 2*(2*M)*q*d := by exact dvd_trans (dvd_mul_left _ _) ((dvd_mul_right (2*(2*M)) q).trans (dvd_mul_right _ d))
      have hcop : n.Coprime (2*M) := hn.coprime_dvd_right hdn
      have hg : IsCoprime (n : ℤ) ((2*M : ℕ) : ℤ) := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hcop
      have hlift : ξ' (n : ZMod (2*M)) = ξ (n : ZMod M) := by
        simpa [ξ'] using DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' ξ div hg
      simpa [tw,hlift] using hc.2 n (hn.coprime_dvd_right divAll)
    exact p.bounds ξ' i j hij N χ hc' y (hV.trans hy) (hyy.trans g.2.2.2.2.le)
  · intro ρ hρ hρN i j hij N _ χ hc s hs hb
    have hc' : An.Induces χ (tw ρ.val q d i j) (2*(2*M)*q*d) :=
      ⟨hc.1,fun n hn => hc.2 n (hn.coprime_dvd_right divAll)⟩
    exact p.boxes ρ hρ (hρN.trans div8) i j hij N χ hc' s hs (hb.trans (g.2.2.2.1 j).le)

theorem guardOpen {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) {eps J Y : ℝ} (hy : 1 < Y) :
    ∃ r > (0:ℝ), ∀ V, |V-Y| < r → Guard M eps J Y V := by
  have yp : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have yne : Y ≠ 0 := yp.ne'
  have zn : ContinuousAt (z eps) Y := by unfold z; fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  have hn : ContinuousAt (h eps) Y := by unfold h; fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  have zq : ContinuousAt (fun v => Real.exp (z eps v/2)) Y := by fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  have hd : ContinuousAt (fun v => Real.exp (h eps v/2)) Y := by fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  have zsmall := zn.tendsto.eventually_lt_const (show z eps Y < nextInt (z eps Y) from Nat.lt_floor_add_one _)
  have qsmall := zq.tendsto.eventually_lt_const (show Real.exp (z eps Y/2) < nextInt (Real.exp (z eps Y / 2)) from Nat.lt_floor_add_one _)
  have dsmall := hd.tendsto.eventually_lt_const (show Real.exp (h eps Y/2) < nextInt (Real.exp (h eps Y / 2)) from Nat.lt_floor_add_one _)
  have ht (j : Fin 2) : ContinuousAt (fun v => height M eps v j) Y := by unfold height; fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  have hp (j : Fin 2) : 0 < height M eps Y j := by unfold height; positivity
  have htwo (j : Fin 2) : height (2*M) eps Y j = 2*height M eps Y j := by unfold height; push_cast; ring
  have bh (j : Fin 2) : ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 Y, height M eps v j < height (2*M) eps Y j :=
    (ht j).tendsto.eventually_lt_const (by rw [htwo]; linarith [hp j])
  have bh' := Filter.eventually_all.2 bh
  have powlim : ContinuousAt (fun v : ℝ => v^J) Y := by fun_prop (disch := aesop)
  have pw : Y^J < Y^(J+1) := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hy (by linarith)
  have pp := powlim.tendsto.eventually_lt_const pw
  have hall : ∀ᶠ V in 𝓝 Y, Guard M eps J Y V := by
    filter_upwards [zsmall,qsmall,dsmall,bh',pp] with V a b c f g
    exact ⟨a,b,c,f,g⟩
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hh⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 hall
  exact ⟨r,hr,fun V hv => hh (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hv)⟩

/-- The comparison schedule is fixed before the primes. One pair works for the
entire right-neighborhood, for two different canonical outer queries in particular. -/
theorem commonNeighborhood (p : PairEx) (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (eps J : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < eps) (h52 : eps < 1/52) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀, ∃ r > (0:ℝ), ∃ q d : ℕ,
      ∀ V : ℝ, Y ≤ V → V < Y+r → PairGood M eps V (V^J) q d := by
  obtain ⟨Y₁,hp⟩ := p (2*M) (by omega) eps (J+1) he h52 (by linarith)
  refine ⟨max 2 Y₁,?_⟩
  intro Y hY
  have hY1 : 1 < Y := by have := (le_max_left (2:ℝ) Y₁).trans hY; linarith
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hg⟩ := guardOpen hM (eps := eps) (J := J) hY1
  obtain ⟨q,d,hp⟩ := hp Y ((le_max_right _ _).trans hY)
  refine ⟨r,hr,q,d,?_⟩
  intro V hV hVr
  exact goodTransport hM he.le hY1.le hV (hg V (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hV)]; linarith)) hp

/-- The original cohomological selector can be called at every resulting outer
scale with the same prime pair. No identification of the returned W or their
exceptional lists is part of this conclusion. -/
theorem successiveSelections (psi : PChar) (eps : ℝ) (he : 0 < eps) (h52 : eps < 1/52)
    (e : ℝ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ u ≥ (1:ℝ), PageN eps u (e u))
    (vwin : VWinAt psi 401) (pex : PairEx) :
    ∃ J : ℝ, 1 ≤ J ∧ ∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ Y ≥ Y₀, ∃ r > (0:ℝ), ∃ q d : ℕ,
      ∀ V : ℝ, Y ≤ V → V < Y+r →
        PairGood psi.N eps V (V^J) q d ∧
        ∃ W : ℝ, V ≤ W ∧ W^(2:ℝ) ≤ V^J ∧
          ∀ u : ℝ, W ≤ u → u ≤ W^(2:ℝ) → VAt psi eps 401 q d (e u) u := by
  obtain ⟨J,hJ,X₀,hW⟩ := vwin eps he h52 e hp
  have hj : 0 < J := by linarith
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := commonNeighborhood pex psi.N (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne _)) eps J he h52 hJ
  refine ⟨J,hJ,max B (max X₀ 2),?_⟩
  intro Y hy
  obtain ⟨r,hr,q,d,hqd⟩ := hB Y ((le_max_left _ _).trans hy)
  refine ⟨r,hr,q,d,?_⟩
  intro V hyv hv
  have H := hqd V hyv hv
  have hvx := ((le_max_left X₀ 2).trans (le_max_right B _)).trans (hy.trans hyv)
  have hv2 := ((le_max_right X₀ 2).trans (le_max_right B _)).trans (hy.trans hyv)
  have hv1 : 1 ≤ V := by linarith
  have hu : V ≤ V^J := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hv1 hJ
  have hid : (V^J)^(1/J) = V := by
    rw [one_div,Real.rpow_rpow_inv (by linarith : 0 ≤ V) hj.ne']
  have hw := hW (V^J) (hvx.trans hu) q d
  rw [hid] at hw
  exact ⟨H,hw H.pair⟩

/-- Fix a target before choosing the primes. Every allowed query contains it
in its ambient domain; its selected arithmetic subwindow is still existential. -/
theorem prescribedAmbient (pex : PairEx) (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (eps J : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < eps) (h52 : eps < 1/52) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, ∀ a b Y : ℝ, T ≤ Y → Y < a → a ≤ b → b ≤ Y^J →
      ∃ r > (0:ℝ), ∃ q d : ℕ, ∀ V : ℝ, Y ≤ V → V < Y+r →
        Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.Icc V (V^J) ∧ PairGood M eps V (V^J) q d := by
  obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := commonNeighborhood pex M hM eps J he h52 hJ
  refine ⟨max T 1,?_⟩
  intro a b Y hy ha _ hb
  obtain ⟨r,hr,q,d,hqd⟩ := hT Y ((le_max_left _ _).trans hy)
  refine ⟨min r (a-Y),lt_min hr (by linarith),q,d,?_⟩
  intro V hyV hV
  obtain ⟨hVr,hVa⟩ : V < Y+r ∧ V < a := by
    constructor
    · linarith [min_le_left r (a-Y)]
    · linarith [min_le_right r (a-Y)]
  refine ⟨?_,hqd V hyV hVr⟩
  intro x hx
  have hy0 := (le_max_right T (1:ℝ)).trans hy
  exact ⟨hVa.le.trans hx.1,hx.2.trans (hb.trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) hyV (by linarith)))⟩

end SuccessivePairs

theorem placeEquiv_symm_map (ψ : F ≃+* F') :
    placeEquiv (RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv ψ.symm) =
      (placeEquiv (RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv ψ)).symm := rfl

def Corr (ψ : F ≃+* F') (S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))) (S' : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F'))) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ v, v ∈ S ↔ placeEquiv (RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv ψ) v ∈ S'

theorem Corr.symm {ψ : F ≃+* F'} {S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))}
    {S' : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F'))} (h : Corr ψ S S') : Corr ψ.symm S' S := by
  intro w
  rw [placeEquiv_symm_map, h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

theorem unram_tr (ψ : F ≃+* F') (e : Ω ≃+* Ω')
    (he : ∀ x, e (algebraMap F Ω x) = algebraMap F' Ω' (ψ x))
    {S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))} {S' : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F'))} (hS : Corr ψ S S')
    {E : IntermediateField F Ω} (hE : IsUnramifiedOutside S E) :
    IsUnramifiedOutside S' (tr ψ e he E) := by
  intro w hw
  set f := RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv ψ with hf
  set v := (placeEquiv f).symm w with hv
  have hvS : v ∉ S := fun h => hw (by
    have h2 : placeEquiv f v ∈ S' := (hS v).1 h
    rwa [hv, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2)
  have hcompat : ∀ r : 𝓞 F, RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv (resEquiv e E (tr ψ e he E) (mem_tr ψ e he E))
      (algebraMap (𝓞 F) (𝓞 E) r) = algebraMap (𝓞 F') (𝓞 (tr ψ e he E)) (f r) := fun r =>
    Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (he (r : F)))
  have h1 := isUnramifiedIn_transport f _ hcompat v.asIdeal (hE v hvS)
  have hw' : v.asIdeal.comap f.symm = w.asIdeal :=
    congrArg HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal ((placeEquiv f).apply_symm_apply w)
  rwa [hw'] at h1

/-- An upper-bound exception set can be enlarged, at a cost of at most one in the cap. -/
theorem firstBound_insert {l R c Z : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L]
    {E : Finset ℕ} (h : FirstBound l R c L Z E) (a : ℕ) :
    FirstBound l (R + 1) c L Z (insert a E) := by
  refine ⟨(Finset.card_insert_le a E).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right h.1 1), ?_⟩
  intro e hpos hZ hnot m F _ _ _ hF
  have hold := h.2 e hpos hZ (fun he => hnot (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem he)) m F hF
  have hj : jZero l R ≤ jZero l (R + 1) :=
    Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.log_mono_right (Nat.le_succ R)) 3
  apply hold.trans
  exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_succ R)
    (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le_max_left m hj) c) (Nat.log l Z))

/-- Apply the original `exc` result before naming an integer in a looser witness. -/
theorem can_mark_after_exc {l R : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L]
    (h : ABound l R L) (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ∧ ∀ Z : ℕ,
      ∃ E : Finset ℕ, a ∈ E ∧ FirstBound l (R + 1) c L Z E := by
  obtain ⟨c, hroot, pick⟩ := exc l R L h
  refine ⟨c, hroot, fun Z => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hb⟩ := pick Z
  exact ⟨insert a E, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, firstBound_insert hb a⟩

/-- Re-express the arithmetic clause of an original center witness with its parameters. -/
def AwayBound (l R : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L : Type) [Field L]
    (K : Type) [NormedField K] (c r : ℕ) (s : Fin r → K) : Prop :=
  ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Algebra L F],
    IsLayer l m L F → ∀ B : ℕ, (∀ i, (l : ℝ) ^ (-(B : ℤ)) ≤ ‖s i - (e : K)‖) →
      shaInv F l e ≤ ((r * (max m (jZero l R) + c + B) : ℕ) : ℕ∞)

/-- At fixed cap, an unused center slot accepts any nominated center. -/
theorem awayBound_cons {l R : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L]
    {K : Type} [NormedField K] {c r : ℕ} {s : Fin r → K}
    (h : AwayBound l R L K c r s) (a : K) :
    AwayBound l R L K c (r + 1) (Fin.cons a s) := by
  intro e he m F _ _ _ hF B hf
  have hOld := h e he m F hF B (fun i => by simpa using hf i.succ)
  exact hOld.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ r))

/-- Record a center along with every clause of the original ABound. -/
def HasNamedCenter (l R : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L : Type) [Field L] (a : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∃ (K : Type) (_ : NormedField K) (_ : NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] K) (_ : IsUltrametricDist K)
    (c r : ℕ) (s : Fin r → K), r ≤ R ∧ (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (l ^ c)) ∧
    AwayBound l R L K c r s ∧ ∃ i, s i = (a : K)) ∧ SecondBound l R L

theorem forget_named {l R : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L] {a : ℕ}
    (h : HasNamedCenter l R L a) : ABound l R L := by
  obtain ⟨⟨K, hK, halg, hU, c, r, s, hcap, hroot, hfar, _⟩, h2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨⟨K, hK, halg, hU, c, r, s, hcap, hroot, hfar⟩, h2⟩

/-- Retain the old away-from-centers bound and use the second bound at the new tower level. -/
theorem name_with_second {l R S : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L]
    (h : ABound l R L) (room : R < S) (second : SecondBound l S L) (a : ℕ) :
    HasNamedCenter l S L a := by
  obtain ⟨⟨K, hK, alg, hU, c, r, s, hcap, hroot, hfar⟩, _⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨K, hK, alg, hU, c, r + 1, Fin.cons (a : K) s, by omega, hroot, ?_,
    ⟨0, by simp⟩⟩, second⟩
  apply awayBound_cons
  intro e he m F _ _ _ hF B hf
  have hj : jZero l R ≤ jZero l S := Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.log_mono_right room.le) 3
  apply (hfar e he m F hF B hf).trans
  exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_left r (Nat.add_le_add_right
    (Nat.add_le_add_right (max_le_max_left m hj) c) B)

theorem tower_succ {l R : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    (tower : Tower.IsTower l L R) : Tower.IsTower l L (R + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨π, covers⟩ := tower.gen
  let drop : (Fin (R+1) → ℤ_[l]) →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) :=
    { toFun := fun f i => f i.succ, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  refine ⟨tower.complex, tower.mu, by omega, π ∘ₗ drop, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := covers y
  exact ⟨Fin.cons 0 x, by simpa [drop, Fin.cons_succ] using hx⟩

theorem tower_can_name {l R : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {L : Type} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    (tower : Tower.IsTower l L R)
    (supply : ∀ S, Tower.IsTower l L S → ABound l S L) (a : ℕ) :
    HasNamedCenter l (R+1) L a :=
  name_with_second (supply R tower) (Nat.lt_succ_self R) (supply (R+1) (tower_succ tower)).2 a

theorem near_named {K : Type} [NormedField K] {s : K} {a : ℕ}
    (h : s = (a : K)) : ‖s - (a : K)‖ < (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log 3 64 : ℤ)) := by
  rw [h, sub_self, norm_zero]
  positivity

/-- Use the source's genuine strict-neighborhood filter on a witness with a named center. -/
theorem named_filter {R : ℕ} {L : Type} [Field L] {a : ℕ}
    (h : HasNamedCenter 3 R L a) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hZ : a ≤ 64) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ c)) ∧
      ∃ E : Finset ℕ, a ∈ E ∧ FirstBound 3 R c L 64 E := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨K, _, _, _, c, r, s, hcap, hroot, hfar, i, hi⟩, _⟩ := h
  let near := fun k : Fin r => (Finset.Icc 1 64 : Finset ℕ).filter
    (fun e : ℕ => ‖s k - (e : K)‖ < (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log 3 64 : ℤ)))
  let E := Finset.univ.biUnion near
  have hmem : a ∈ E := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _,
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨ha,hZ⟩, near_named hi⟩⟩
  refine ⟨c, hroot, E, hmem, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have lone : ∀ k, (near k).card ≤ 1 := by
      intro k
      apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
      intro u hu v hv
      obtain ⟨hur,hu'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hu
      obtain ⟨hvr,hv'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
      exact near1 3 K (s k) 64 u v (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hur).1 (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hur).2
        (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hvr).1 (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hvr).2 hu' hv'
    calc E.card ≤ ∑ k : Fin r, (near k).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
         _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin r, 1 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => lone k
         _ = r := by simp
         _ ≤ R := hcap
  · intro e he heZ hnot m F _ _ _ hF
    have away : ∀ k, (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log 3 64 : ℤ)) ≤ ‖s k - (e : K)‖ := by
      intro k
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro hk
      exact hnot (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ _,
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨he,heZ⟩, hk⟩⟩)
    apply (hfar e he m F hF (Nat.log 3 64) away).trans
    exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcap

theorem tower_filter_at_one {R : ℕ} {L : Type} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    (tower : Tower.IsTower 3 L R) (supply : ∀ S, Tower.IsTower 3 L S → ABound 3 S L) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, (∃ ζ : L, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (3 ^ c)) ∧
      ∃ E : Finset ℕ, 1 ∈ E ∧ FirstBound 3 (R+1) c L 64 E :=

  dsimp only
  rw [← Ideal.map_pow, ← map_pow, hx, Ideal.relNorm_singleton, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,

      conjugate_mod_difference K E σ hg τ c
    simp_rw [hinv] at he
    simpa [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard] using he.symm

omit [IsGalois K E] in
/-- Norm in the other direction after extending a downstairs ideal class. -/
theorem norm_extend_class (c : Cl K) :
    clNorm K (ClassGroup.extendedHom (𝓞 K) (𝓞 E) c) = c ^ Module.finrank K E := by
  obtain ⟨I, rfl⟩ := ClassGroup.mk0_surjective c
  rw [ClassGroup.extendedHom_mk0, class_norm_mk, ← map_pow]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Ideal.relNorm (𝓞 K) (Ideal.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (𝓞 E)) I.val) = I.val ^ _
  rw [Ideal.relNorm_algebraMap, IsFractionRing.finrank_eq (𝓞 K) K (𝓞 E) E]

omit [IsGalois K E] in
/-- Downstairs cubing is onto, so every downstairs class is the norm of an extended class. -/
theorem norm_on_coinvariants_surjective (σ : Gal(E/K)) (hd : Module.finrank K E = 3)
    (h : ¬ 3 ∣ Nat.card (Cl K)) : Function.Surjective (normOnCoinvariants K E σ) := by
  intro c
  have hC : (Nat.card (Cl K)).Coprime 3 :=
    ((Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd (by decide : Nat.Prime 3)).2 h).symm
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hC.pow_left_bijective.surjective c
  refine ⟨QuotientGroup.mk (ClassGroup.extendedHom (𝓞 K) (𝓞 E) a), ?_⟩
  change clNorm K (ClassGroup.extendedHom (𝓞 K) (𝓞 E) a) = c
  simpa only [norm_extend_class, hd] using ha

end ClassNorm

open NextLayer

/-- An independently established prime-to-three tower gives the exact fixed-class divisibility. -/
theorem fixed_of_regular_tower (h : TowerClassHyp) : FixedClassDivisibility := by
  intro k
  let _ := step_galois k
  exact fixed_card_divides_of_regular (Lower k) (Upper k) (step_group k).1 (h (k+2) (by omega))

theorem coinvariant_of_regular_tower (h : TowerClassHyp) : CoinvariantNormInjectivity := by
  intro k
  let _ := step_galois k
  let _ := (step_group k).2
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := Gal(Upper k / Lower k))
  exact ⟨σ, hσ, norm_on_coinvariants_of_regular _ _ σ hσ (step_group k).1 (h (k+2) (by omega))⟩

theorem norm_equiv_of_regular_tower (h : TowerClassHyp) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(Upper k / Lower k), (∀ τ, τ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ) ∧
      Function.Bijective (normOnCoinvariants (Lower k) (Upper k) σ) := by
  obtain ⟨σ, hg, hi⟩ := coinvariant_of_regular_tower h k
  let _ := step_galois k
  exact ⟨σ, hg, hi, norm_on_coinvariants_surjective _ _ σ (step_degree k)
    (regular_lower (fixed_of_regular_tower h) k)⟩

theorem fixed_card_eq_lower (h : TowerClassHyp) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (FixedClasses (Lower k) (Upper k)) = Nat.card (Cl (Lower k)) := by
  obtain ⟨σ, hg, hb⟩ := norm_equiv_of_regular_tower h k
  rw [fixed_card_eq_coinvariant_card _ _ σ hg]
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective _ hb)

import GroundTheory.GlobalFields.ClassFieldConsequences.HilbertClassField

noncomputable section

open NumberField GroundTheory.Global IntermediateField
open scoped IsMulCommutative

namespace Ascent.Upstairs

local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩

abbrev cubes (A : Type*) [CommGroup A] := (powMonoidHom 3 : A →* A).range

theorem cubes_characteristic (A : Type*) [CommGroup A] : (cubes A).Characteristic := by
  apply Subgroup.characteristic_iff_le_comap.mpr
  intro φ x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨φ y, (map_pow φ y 3).symm⟩

theorem cubes_ne_top (A : Type*) [CommGroup A] [Finite A] (h : 3 ∣ Nat.card A) :
    cubes A ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro hall
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (powMonoidHom 3 : A →* A) := MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mp hall
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := A) 3 h
  have hone : x ^ 3 = 1 := hx ▸ pow_orderOf_eq_one x
  have heq : x = 1 := (Finite.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj) (by simpa using hone)
  simp [heq] at hx

theorem quotient_pgroup (A : Type*) [CommGroup A] : IsPGroup 3 (A ⧸ cubes A) := by
  intro q
  refine QuotientGroup.induction_on q ?_
  intro x
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rw [pow_one, ← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

variable (E : Type) [Field E] [NumberField E] (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [Algebra E Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]

abbrev H := hilbertClassField E Ω
abbrev Elementary : IntermediateField E (H E Ω) :=
  fixedField (cubes (Gal(H E Ω/E)))

theorem hilbert_degree : Module.finrank E (H E Ω) = Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 E)) := by
  rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank]
  exact (Nat.card_congr (hilbertClassFieldArtinEquiv E Ω).toEquiv).symm

theorem elementary_degree_pos (h : 3 ∣ Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 E))) :
    1 < Module.finrank E (Elementary E Ω) := by
  have hcard : 3 ∣ Nat.card (Gal(H E Ω/E)) :=
    (Nat.card_congr (hilbertClassFieldArtinEquiv E Ω).toEquiv) ▸ h
  have hne := cubes_ne_top _ hcard
  have hr := Nat.card_congr (IsGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient (cubes (Gal(H E Ω/E)))).toEquiv
  rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank] at hr
  rw [← hr]
  exact Subgroup.one_lt_index_of_ne_top hne

theorem elementary_pgroup : IsPGroup 3 (Gal(Elementary E Ω/E)) :=
  (quotient_pgroup (Gal(H E Ω/E))).of_equiv
    (IsGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient (cubes (Gal(H E Ω/E))))

theorem elementary_abelian : IsAbelianGalois E (Elementary E Ω) :=
  IsAbelianGalois.tower_bot E (Elementary E Ω) (H E Ω)

theorem elementary_unramified : IsUnramifiedEverywhere E (Elementary E Ω) := by
  have hu := isUnramifiedEverywhere_hilbertClassField E Ω
  let L := Elementary E Ω
  change IsUnramifiedEverywhere E L
  refine ⟨fun v P hP hPv => ?_, fun v w hw => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQP⟩⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (P.primesOver (𝓞 (H E Ω))))
    have hov : Q.LiesOver v.asIdeal := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P v.asIdeal
    have hq := ((GroundTheory.ProfCoh.isUnramifiedAt_tower_iff (F := E) (L := L) Q).1
      (hu.1 v Q hQ hov)).1
    have hp : P = Q.under (𝓞 L) := Ideal.over_def Q P
    subst hp
    exact hq
  · obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := NumberField.InfinitePlace.comap_surjective (K := H E Ω) w
    rw [InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff]
    by_cases hv : v.IsReal
    · left
      have hc : w'.comap (algebraMap E (H E Ω)) = v := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq E L (H E Ω), InfinitePlace.comap_comp, hw]
      have hr := (InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff.1 (hu.2 v w' hc)).resolve_right
        (by rw [hc]; exact InfinitePlace.not_isComplex_iff_isReal.2 hv)
      exact hr.comap _
    · right
      rw [hw]
      exact InfinitePlace.not_isReal_iff_isComplex.1 hv


/-- Conjugating an E-linear automorphism by a downstairs automorphism still fixes E. -/
private def conjugateOver {F E T : Type} [Field F] [Field E] [Field T] [Algebra F E]
    [Algebra E T] [Algebra F T] [IsScalarTower F E T] [Normal F E]
    (σ : Gal(T/F)) (τ : Gal(T/E)) : Gal(T/E) :=
  { (σ.toRingEquiv.trans τ.toRingEquiv).trans σ.symm.toRingEquiv with
    commutes' := fun x => by
      change σ.symm (τ (σ (algebraMap E T x))) = _
      rw [← σ.restrictNormal_commutes E x, τ.commutes, σ.restrictNormal_commutes, σ.symm_apply_apply] }

/-- The fixed field of cubes is normal downstairs whenever the entire Hilbert field is. -/
theorem elementary_galois_downstairs (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F]
    [Algebra F E] [Algebra F (H E Ω)] [IsScalarTower F E (H E Ω)]
    [IsGalois F E] [IsGalois F (H E Ω)] :
    IsGalois F ((Elementary E Ω).restrictScalars F) := by
  refine { to_isSeparable := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable F _ (H E Ω), to_normal := ?_ }
  apply normal_iff_forall_map_le'.mpr
  rintro σ x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  change y ∈ fixedField (cubes (Gal(H E Ω/E))) at hy
  change σ y ∈ fixedField (cubes (Gal(H E Ω/E)))
  rw [mem_fixedField_iff] at hy ⊢
  rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
  let a := conjugateOver σ v
  have ha (t : H E Ω) : σ (a t) = v (σ t) := σ.apply_symm_apply _
  have hb := hy (a ^ 3) ⟨a, rfl⟩
  change v (v (v (σ y))) = σ y
  rw [← ha, ← ha, ← ha]
  exact congrArg σ hb


/-- Degree-three downstairs and a 3-group upstairs give a 3-group over the bottom. -/
theorem galois_p_tower {F E T : Type} [Field F] [Field E] [Field T]
    [Algebra F E] [Algebra E T] [Algebra F T] [IsScalarTower F E T]
    [FiniteDimensional F E] [FiniteDimensional E T] [FiniteDimensional F T]
    [IsGalois E T] [IsGalois F T] (h : Module.finrank F E = 3)
    (hp : IsPGroup 3 (Gal(T/E))) : IsPGroup 3 (Gal(T/F)) := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hp.exists_card_eq
  rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank] at hk
  apply IsPGroup.of_card (n := k + 1)
  rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank F E T, h, hk, pow_succ, mul_comm]

end Ascent.Upstairs

import SlotApplication

open UpperTheory.V.Win

namespace AscentWitness

local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩

theorem near_integer (z : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(z : ℚ_[3])‖ < (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) ↔ (3 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) ∣ z := by
  have hd := Padic.norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd (p := 3) z (k+1)
  change ‖(z : ℚ_[3])‖ ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ (-((k+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ↔ (3 : ℤ) ^ (k+1) ∣ z at hd
  rw [← hd]
  by_cases h : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp <;> positivity
  · have hz : (z : ℚ_[3]) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
    rw [Padic.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hz, show ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 3 by norm_num,
      zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3),
      zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3)]
    push_cast
    omega

/-- Label 0 represents the empty set. Every other label represents its positive weight. -/
theorem label_answers (Z : ℕ) (a : Fin (Z + 1)) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hle : e ≤ Z) :
    e ∈ SlotThree.weightsAt (a.val : ℚ_[3]) Z ↔ a.val = e := by
  classical
  simp only [SlotThree.weightsAt, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, he, hle, and_self, true_and]
  rw [← show (((a.val : ℤ) - e : ℤ) : ℚ_[3]) = (a.val : ℚ_[3]) - e by push_cast; rfl,
      near_integer]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hd : ((a.val : ℤ) - e).natAbs ≤ Z := by have := a.isLt; omega
    have hz := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide : 1 < 3) Z
    have heq := Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs h (by
      rw [Int.natAbs_pow]
      change _ < (3 : ℕ) ^ (Nat.log 3 Z + 1)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hd hz)
    omega
  · intro h
    simp [h]

theorem admissible_label (h : SlotThree.TowerClassHyp) (Z : ℕ) (a : Fin (Z+1)) :
    (SlotThree.SingleCenter (a.val : ℚ_[3]) ∧ SecondBound 3 1 SlotThree.L) ∧
    FirstBound 3 1 1 SlotThree.L Z (SlotThree.weightsAt (a.val : ℚ_[3]) Z) :=
  ⟨SlotThree.any_center h _, SlotThree.firstBound_of_card h _ _ (SlotThree.card_weightsAt _ _)⟩

/-- A tag read once must answer every later in-range membership query. -/
theorem enough_tags (Z : ℕ) {T : Type*} [Fintype T] (record : Fin (Z+1) → T)
    (read : T → ℕ → Prop) (faithful : ∀ a e, 1 ≤ e → e ≤ Z →
      (read (record a) e ↔ e ∈ SlotThree.weightsAt (a.val : ℚ_[3]) Z)) :
    Z + 1 ≤ Fintype.card T := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective record := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Fin.ext
    have same (e : ℕ) (h : 1 ≤ e) (hz : e ≤ Z) : a.val = e ↔ b.val = e := by
      rw [← label_answers Z a e h hz, ← label_answers Z b e h hz,
        ← faithful a e h hz, ← faithful b e h hz, hab]
    have ha := a.isLt
    have hb := b.isLt
    by_cases pos : 1 ≤ a.val
    · exact ((same a.val pos (by omega)).mp rfl).symm
    · by_cases posb : 1 ≤ b.val
      · exact (same b.val posb (by omega)).mpr rfl
      · omega
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective record hinj

/-- All p-adic centers of the cap-one filter admit the matching finite tag. -/
theorem tag_exists (Z : ℕ) (s : ℚ_[3]) :
    ∃ a : Fin (Z+1), ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → e ≤ Z → (e ∈ SlotThree.weightsAt s Z ↔ a.val = e) := by
  classical
  by_cases empty : SlotThree.weightsAt s Z = ∅
  · exact ⟨0, fun e he _ => by simp [empty]; omega⟩
  · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr empty
    have range := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).1
    refine ⟨⟨u, by omega⟩, fun e _ _ => ⟨fun he => ?_, fun he => he ▸ hu⟩⟩
    exact Finset.card_le_one.mp (SlotThree.card_weightsAt s Z) u hu e he

#print axioms near_integer
#print axioms label_answers
#print axioms admissible_label
#print axioms enough_tags
#print axioms tag_exists

end AscentWitness

import Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.AutomorphicVarieties.AdditiveValuationNorms.CokLenLeOfRangeLe
import Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.AutomorphicVarieties.NumberFieldTowers.XTwApplyApply

noncomputable section

namespace SlotThree

local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨by decide⟩

private abbrev ZMat (K : Type) := Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) K

/-- The columns of the zero matrix lift the action through the single zero generator.
The same matrix satisfies the determinant bound in PropA.lift. -/
theorem zero_matrix_lift (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[3] X] [Subsingleton X]
    (A : Module.End ℤ_[3] X) :
    ∃ π : (Fin 1 → ℤ_[3]) →ₗ[ℤ_[3]] X, Function.Surjective π ∧
      (∀ v, π ((0 : ZMat ℤ_[3]).mulVec v) = (A ^ (3 ^ 3 : ℕ)) (π v)) ∧
      ∀ a : ℤ_[3], UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokLen (l := 3) (X := X)
        (a • A ^ (3 ^ 3 : ℕ) - (1 : Module.End ℤ_[3] X)) ≤
        UpperTheory.V.PropA.vl 3 (a • (0 : ZMat ℤ_[3]) - 1).det := by
  refine ⟨0, fun x => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _, ?_⟩
  intro a
  rw [UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokLen, Module.length_eq_zero]
  exact bot_le

/-- Over the same algebraic closure used in detBound the characteristic roots consist of zero. -/
theorem zero_lift_spectrum :
    (0 : ZMat (PadicAlgCl 3)).charpoly.roots = {0} ∧
    ∀ a : PadicAlgCl 3, (a • (0 : ZMat (PadicAlgCl 3)) - 1).det =
      ∏ _i : Fin 1, (a * 0 - 1) := by
  constructor
  · simp [Matrix.charpoly_zero]
  · intro a
    simp

/-- The exact ball inequality at j=3, c=1 and root zero, for every proposed center. -/
def ZeroRootBall (u s : ℤ_[3]) : Prop :=
  ∀ e : ℕ, ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℕ) + 1))⁻¹ * ‖s - e‖ ≤
    ‖algebraMap ℚ_[3] (PadicAlgCl 3) (((u ^ (3 ^ 3 : ℕ)) ^ e : ℤ_[3]) : ℚ_[3]) * 0 - 1‖

theorem zero_root_any_center (u s : ℤ_[3]) : ZeroRootBall u s := by
  intro e
  simp only [mul_zero, zero_sub, norm_neg, norm_one]
  calc
    ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℕ) + 1))⁻¹ * ‖s - e‖ ≤ ((3 : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℕ) + 1))⁻¹ * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (PadicInt.norm_le_one _) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ 1 := by norm_num

/-- Fix the arithmetic module, its endomorphism, j, lift, root and cyclotomic value.
The ball condition admits two centers with opposite strict-filter membership at weight one. -/
theorem same_lift_opposite
    (hX : Subsingleton (UpperTheory.V.Tower.XP 3 (CyclotomicField 3 ℚ)))
    (A : Module.End ℤ_[3] (UpperTheory.V.Tower.XP 3 (CyclotomicField 3 ℚ))) (u : ℤ_[3]) :
    (∃ π : (Fin 1 → ℤ_[3]) →ₗ[ℤ_[3]] UpperTheory.V.Tower.XP 3 (CyclotomicField 3 ℚ),
      Function.Surjective π ∧ ∀ v, π ((0 : ZMat ℤ_[3]).mulVec v) = (A ^ (3 ^ 3 : ℕ)) (π v)) ∧
    (0 : ZMat (PadicAlgCl 3)).charpoly.roots = {0} ∧
    ZeroRootBall u 0 ∧ ZeroRootBall u 1 ∧
    ¬ ‖(0 : ℚ_[3]) - 1‖ < (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log 3 64 : ℤ)) ∧
    ‖(1 : ℚ_[3]) - 1‖ < (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(Nat.log 3 64 : ℤ)) := by
  let _ := hX
  obtain ⟨π, hs, he, _⟩ := zero_matrix_lift _ A
  refine ⟨⟨π, hs, he⟩, zero_lift_spectrum.1, zero_root_any_center _ _,
    zero_root_any_center _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals rw [show Nat.log 3 64 = 3 by decide]
  all_goals norm_num

#print axioms SlotThree.zero_matrix_lift
#print axioms SlotThree.zero_lift_spectrum
#print axioms SlotThree.zero_root_any_center
#print axioms SlotThree.same_lift_opposite
